source_code: The Wolfenstein 3-D source (https://github.com/id-Software/wolf3d) carries id's 1995 LIMITED USE SOFTWARE LICENSE AGREEMENT (README.rst, LICENCE.DOC); John Carmack wrote that it was later released under the GPL (idstuff/wolf3d/wolf3d_iphone_v1.2_src.txt).
